Ore Buffer: writeUnsynchronized(data, size, offset, discard) for an append-only uniform ring that binds one buffer at many dynamic offsets within a frame. It writes [offset, offset + size) of the storage already bound, without the orphan update() does when the buffer was bound since its last update, because the caller guarantees no recorded command reads that range. discard marks the first write of a new use of the buffer: storage the GPU may still read is replaced without copying, so every byte outside the written range becomes undefined. The bound-since-update state is left alone, so a later update() still orphans. The base default is update(), correct but slow, which is what GL (glBufferSubData at the offset, implicitly synchronized) and D3D12 use. Contract the ring relies on: within a frame each range is written at most once and only before the commands reading it are recorded, since on WebGPU every queued write lands before that frame's submit
